Subject: Spend ladder alignment — monthly-burn band & PO gates

Hi Kelly — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and the asks I promised: 

1) High-level thesis from our call
- You expect to start with a pilot that will spike during product launch windows, then settle to a steady-state ingestion for personalized content generation.
- Primary workload: short-form generation + reranking for recommendations (avg seq length ~120 tokens).

2) Pricing/volume items we need to validate (can you confirm):
- Estimated monthly token volume: 80M — 200M tokens (you mentioned a 100M baseline during the call).
- Target unit economics target: ~$900–$1,200 per 1M tokens (I noted your team is aiming for ~$/1M bands rather than per-request price).
- Procurement threshold: does BrightEdge require a formal PO signoff for monthly spend above $50k or is the threshold $75k? Also curious about preferred billing cadence (monthly vs. quarterly).

3) What we’ll send next
- A short cost envelope with two scenarios (conservative and launch spike) and an example PO language we’ve used previously. See attached sample-pricing-breakdown.csv for example math.

If you can reply with a confirmed monthly band and the PO threshold (and any internal approvers), I’ll put together a mutual action plan and a one-page pilot estimate.

Thanks again — enjoyed the product walkthrough.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0187

From: Kelly Burns <kelly@brightedgehealth.com>

Cc: BrightEdge Health Procurement <procurement@brightedgehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spend ladder alignment — monthly-burn band & PO gates

Connor — thanks for the recap and for the spreadsheet. Quick answers from our side: 

- Monthly token band: realistic run rate we expect is 80M–150M tokens/month for the first 6 months; in peak campaigns we could hit ~200M for 4–6 week windows.
- Target price: our finance team is aiming for a $/1M target of $1,000 (give or take $200) — would prioritize predictability over lowest price.
- PO threshold & procurement rules: any vendor invoices > $60k/month require procurement approval and a signed PO; above $150k/month we'd need an executive procurement review and a 30–45 day lead time before start. We prefer quarterly invoices where possible.

I've attached some SOW questions from our legal team — nothing major but they'd like to see data retention and audit log language early.

Kelly Burns
Director, Product Ops — BrightEdge Health
kelly@brightedgehealth.com | +1 (212) 555-3321

Attachment: BrightEdge-SOW-questions.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

Kelly / team — thanks for the clarity. A couple practical notes from pricing/CS so the numbers line up with procurement expectations: 

- Pricing model options we recommend:
  * Hosted pay-as-you-go with tiered $/1M discounts at 100M and 200M bands (fast to start, little lead time).
  * Dedicated reserved pool (monthly commit) for predictable unit economics at higher volumes — helps reduce $/1M by ~15–30% depending on commit.

- Example math (illustrative):
  * Conservative: 80M tokens @ $1,000 / 1M = $80k / month.
  * Launch spike: 200M tokens @ $950 / 1M = $190k / month (would trigger exec procurement review per your threshold).

- Procurement & ops checklist:
  * PO threshold: we can support month-to-month billing up to $60k without a long lead time. For $60k–$150k, plan for a 15–30 day procurement lead time; above $150k expect 30–45 day lead time + legal review.
  * Data security: we can provide SOC2 evidence and a redacted audit log sample.
  * Pilot recommendation: 3-month pilot with a 100M commit band; convert to reserved pool if monthly run rate stays >120M.

Next steps: Connor — I can draft the 1-page estimate and include two billing options (monthly vs quarterly invoicing) and attach the pilot estimate spreadsheet. Marissa, would you want to review the PO language we normally use?

Naomi Feldman
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: pilot-estimate-connor-2026-08.xlsx (Excel, 3 sheets)
